title: I Gave Zach 1 Queen Each Game Until I LOSE
summary: Player (white, full army) vs Zach (1 Elo chess.com bot) who receives extra queens each game until the player loses. Game 1: Zach starts with a single queen (normal setup); player wins easily (ladder of checks). Game 2: six more queens added (7 total) - player gobbles them 'hungry hippo style' and promotes, ladder mate. Game 3: chess.com refuses a full extra row of queens (bots freeze), so the maximum allowed queens plus extra rooks/bishops are added; player picks off the queens with a lone knight and promotes - win. Player can't add more material, so 'failed' to lose.
rules: Player white: standard full army. Bot black: Zach (1 Elo) with extra queens placed on its side.
Game 1: Zach's normal single queen; Game 2: 7 queens total; Game 3: as many queens as chess.com allows plus extra rooks/bishops (an entire extra row of queens makes the bots freeze).
After each player win, add queens; challenge ends when player loses (never happened).
win_condition: Keep winning as Zach gets more queens. Video: won every game; could not add more material.
